name: personal-feature-agent
description: Turn a small feature request into an approved specification, working code, and a verified local environment.

interface.shortDescription: Ship a reviewed feature into a runnable local environment.
interface.longDescription: Draft and approve a lightweight requirement, implement it in the current repository, run the repository's own build and tests, start a development environment, and return verification evidence.
